permission_open_gates_reference: Qualified DIC presence/PGOOD filtering, CDONE qualification and positive tamper-clear generation remain upstream boundaries.
Bank-B qualified buffer-enable term is an input; actual Ioff buffer gating remains unimplemented.
PERMIT_OUT_DRIVE is logic only; no photorelay or field contact is implemented in this block.
Physical reset/clock recovery and removal pulses, full runtime/self-test integration and loaded timing require qualification.
Trip capture requires actual SET1 setup/hold at inverted WD_OK rising edges; coincident edges remain unqualified.
WD_REARM_M/O are explicit record-clear strobes; logic owner must issue them only after storage while disarmed, not as healthy-state rearm levels.
Proposed 4.7k GPIO pulls require versioned interface reconciliation, not an in-place IS-1 edit.

TX_PERMIT.receiver: card-qualified Schmitt gate; exact aggregate fanout unqualified

warnings: Reference snapshot only. No CAD/gateware/source net was changed.
Native XML connections are schematic/source evidence, not routed physical connections.
MC card names and handoff endpoints are historical physical labels to revise with explicit IS-2 onboard health semantics; do not assert nonexistent removable cards are healthy.
Existing candidate FPGA balls must be reconciled with all required motherboard signal/bank/voltage assignments and vendor fit.
